context: M28 o4. (Delphine.) 34th & Seventh. The garment operators turn the corner with a union banner.

lines.speaker: char.mei_lin_chow
lines.text: Union lady said wait. Machines don't wait. We came.

lines.speaker: char.carmen_arce
lines.text: You're Teddy's friend. The one he gave the fifty back to. Ay, he told me nothing.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: He tells everyone nothing, Mrs. Arce. It's how I knew he was honest.

lines.speaker: char.carmen_arce
lines.text: Walk with us. Women in front. Men carry the banner. Men are good at carrying.
